reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the General Election
reports.notes: Handwritten over a partly pre-filled sheet. STRUCK-THROUGH VALUES: lines 5 and 7 each carry a machine-printed '$0.00' that has been struck through with a pen, with the filer's hand-written figure written ABOVE it - the SURVIVING (hand-written) values 640.00 and 500.00 are what is recorded here; the struck '$0.00' is not. Same superscript-cents notation as this filer's June report ('640' with a raised '00'); hand-drawn '$' signs dropped per spec. Line 3 is written as a doubled zero with raised cents, transcribed verbatim as '00.00' (i.e. the filer's way of writing zero) at medium confidence. Column B cents on lines 1 and 2 (1,444.16 / 944.16) are small raised, underlined pairs - medium confidence. Nothing was arithmetic-derived.
